proof_body:
by
  intro a k hk
  have hk' : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hx0 := Int.emod_nonneg (-a) hk'.ne'
  have hx1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (-a) hk'
  have hcast : (((-a) % k).toNat : ℤ) = (-a) % k := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hx0
  refine ⟨((-a) % k).toNat, ⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcast]
    have h1 := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (-a) k
    exact ⟨-((-a) / k), by linear_combination h1⟩
  · rintro j ⟨hj, hjd⟩
    have h1 : (k : ℤ) ∣ a + ((-a) % k) := by
      have h2 := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (-a) k
      exact ⟨-((-a) / k), by linear_combination h2⟩
    have h2 : (k : ℤ) ∣ (j : ℤ) - ((-a) % k) := by
      have := dvd_sub hjd h1
      simpa using this
    have h3 : (j : ℤ) - ((-a) % k) = 0 := by
      apply Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd h2
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> omega
    omega
